name: Puigpelat (Spain)
description: Red field with black stripes along the upper and lower edges, each edged with a thin white stripe, charged at the centre with a white Maltese cross.
history: The official flag of Puigpelat is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with a white Maltese cross of height 3/13 of the cloth at the centre, and two juxtaposed fesses above and below, one white of thickness 1/13 and one black; approved on 19 November 2007 and published in the DOGC on 4 December 2007, based on the arms.
